ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 60% of the visible surface area on the lateral lobes, while low-intensity black pixels occupy approximately 40% concentrated in the central region and along the distal edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region contains a large, low-intensity contiguous black 'butterfly' pattern. This is flanked by high-intensity white contiguous zones on the left and right lobes. The interface between these zones displays heavy stochastic mottling. A consistent low-intensity black border is mapped along the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the fluke's total height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations across the span; distal sections exhibit higher-amplitude peaks (2-5 pixels in height) compared to the smoother, lower-amplitude topography near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a smooth concave curve from the notch toward the tips, while the visible portions of the lateral boundaries exhibit a strong convex sweep upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity white and tan pixel groups (barnacles) are localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the high-intensity white sections of both lobes; notably, two parallel marks on the left lobe and one prominent vertical mark on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips resulting in significant localized surface elevation and high-contrast pixel clusters; minor irregular indentations along the trailing edge suggest historical mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy salt-and-pepper mottling at the pigment transition zones, particularly concentrated around the mid-section of the trailing edge on both lobes.
